provenance_note: Created 2026-06-29 from the Logos governance dependency-map pattern, translated into LawFirm OS control-plane, client-data, privacy, compliance, automation-authority, and repo-ownership terms. Updated 2026-07-08 for DAD transport surface v1 rollout: AI front-door and TOC paths now point to versioned DAD local-pull transport metadata while preserving upstream governance-map authority, child-repo local authority, candidate-only data handling, and no external write authorization.
reason_for_inclusion: Governance-facing changes must update the map, local mirrors, discovery surfaces, and validators deterministically instead of relying on chat memory or local convenience.

artifacts.title: Validation runtime policy and pytest wrapper
artifacts.provenance_note: Added 2026-06-30 after local full pytest exceeded a short/default 300 second ceiling; updated to a 3600 second policy floor after cross-repo validation showed shorter ceilings still cause avoidable reruns. The wrapper applies the policy and blocks raw pytest.
artifacts.reason_for_inclusion: Validation command surfaces can change effective governance by turning slow tests into false failures; the timeout policy must be discoverable and enforced.

paths: GitHub branch protection settings for main
open_questions.question: Should the owner make LawFirm-os-intake public, upgrade the GitHub plan, or otherwise enable branch protection so the Intake governance-map mirror and PR-description workflows cannot be bypassed on main?
open_questions.reason: Branch protection and required governance checks were enabled on 2026-07-06 for the five public kernel repos. GitHub returned HTTP 403 for LawFirm-os-intake because branch protection for that private repo requires GitHub Pro or making the repo public.
